terms.definition: The jelly-like material inside the cell membrane that holds the organelles.
terms.function: Supports organelles, hosts reactions, and provides the path for transport.
terms.whereItIs: Everything between the cell membrane and the nucleus.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the workspace in which all the cell's organelles do their jobs.

terms.definition: The fluid part of the cytoplasm, mostly water with dissolved molecules.
terms.function: Provides the medium in which reactions happen and materials dissolve.
terms.whereItIs: Filling the spaces between the organelles.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the solvent in which the cell's chemistry takes place.

terms.definition: The flowing movement of the cytoplasm that carries materials around the cell.
terms.function: Moves organelles and materials from one region to another.
terms.whyItMatters: It is how the cell distributes materials without a plumbing system.
